title: Motiq — Robotics, AI & intelligent automation
description: Motiq develops robotics, computer vision and private AI solutions. A small engineering team connecting perception, reasoning and action. Selected for AI-BOOST ADVANCE.
hero.lead: We connect robots, computer vision and AI to automate real tasks. From an early prototype to the software and infrastructure it needs to run.

services.title: One team. From perception to action.
services.lead: Robotics and AI are our focus. Computer vision, software and reliable infrastructure bring them together.
robotics.label: 01 / ROBOTICS
robotics.title: Robotics & computer vision
robotics.copy: Help robots understand a scene and work with objects. We develop perception, robotic software and prototypes that can be tested.
robotics.detail: Start with the task and real examples. Test perception and robot behaviour in simulation, then evaluate on the selected hardware.
ai.label: 02 / ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
ai.title: AI that fits your workflow
ai.copy: Private assistants and AI agents for documents, data and repetitive work. Connected to the tools your team actually uses.
ai.detail: Answers with traceable sources, clear access rules and human review where it matters. Run locally or in the cloud to fit the project.
cloud.label: 03 / EDGE & CLOUD
cloud.title: A foundation that keeps up
cloud.copy: The runtime behind robotics and AI: local processing, cloud infrastructure, deployment and observability.
cloud.detail: Reproducible environments, CI/CD, monitoring, backups and cost visibility. A practical setup that your team can maintain.
boost.title: From human instruction to a robot mission.
boost.copy: Our proposal was selected for the ADVANCE phase of the AI-BOOST AI Challenge Competition. In Challenge 1, we are developing an approach to natural-language mission generation for autonomous robots in agriculture.
boost.statusCopy: Currently at prototype stage. Validation on the target robot is part of the development work.
boost.step1Copy: Connect an instruction to the scene, context and intended goal.
boost.step2Copy: Build a proposed mission from the actions the robot supports.
boost.step3Copy: Check the plan, explain unsupported requests and ask the operator to confirm.
work.title: Ideas we are putting to the test.
work.lead: Alongside client work, we develop tools and prototypes at the intersection of robotics and AI.
work.roboticsCopy: Collecting visual data and exploring perception for robotic handling, including the difficult case of transparent materials.
work.aiCopy: AI assistants and agents that connect information and actions across software, with clear sources and human oversight.
demo.title: Your documents. A useful answer.
demo.copy: Ask a question, get a concise answer and check its source. We can build this around your own documents and access rules.
